adaptations: Rendered the acquired Mini Skate 1.2 pallet mesh with its original external colormap. Geometry, materials, textures and source node transforms remain unchanged; only the root is recentered.
Low three-quarter camera and studio lighting retain the three top slats, spacer/support blocks and visible side fork opening. The optional carton is omitted; no additional model parts were invented.
Transparent 768 by 768 render, alpha-bounds crop with 16-pixel padding and Lanczos reduction to 512 by 278. The accepted PNG is copied exactly.

Root inspected eight source views, actual native Match 126 by 72 and Memory 144 by 74 cards in unmatched/matched states, and comparison with the accepted cart/basket. Matched badges leave the principal slats and lower opening readable. This is scoped AI picture review, not a participant recognition study or pallet-load specification.
